ancestries.name: Dwarf
ancestries.description: Short, sturdy folk renowned for their craftsmanship, resilience, and deep affinity for stone and metal.

ancestries.name: Elf
ancestries.description: Graceful, long-lived people with a deep connection to nature, magic, and the ancient world.

ancestries.name: Gnome
ancestries.description: Small, fey-touched folk with boundless curiosity, eccentric personalities, and a vulnerability to the Bleaching.

ancestries.name: Goblin
ancestries.description: Small, excitable, and often misunderstood folk with a love for fire, noise, and unconventional problem-solving.

ancestries.name: Halfling
ancestries.description: Small, cheerful folk known for their luck, adaptability, and talent for blending into communities of larger peoples.

ancestries.name: Human
ancestries.description: Adaptable and ambitious people found in every corner of Golarion, known for their drive, versatility, and short but impactful lives.
